rationale: The Latin anchors *adhibere* (to apply, furnish) and *subministrare* (to supply, furnish) both point to a concrete sense of giving or furnishing something useful or necessary, which aligns best with supply.v.01 ("give something useful or necessary to"). This is more literal and concrete than the sustenance-focused provide.v.02 or the legal/contingency sense of provide.v.03.
